all_tweets.title: Copper has expanded its OTC derivatives solution with the launch of ClearLoop Assigned Collateral, a
all_tweets.description:
Copper has expanded its OTC derivatives solution with the launch of ClearLoop Assigned Collateral, adding to its existing triparty pledge service. 
 
Structural tension around collateral has long challenged OTC crypto derivatives markets; balancing Dealers’ capital efficiency with Takers’ need to manage counterparty risk.
 
Our new solution, powered by ClearLoop, delivers both. 
 
- For Takers, collateral is restricted for use within the Dealer’s ClearLoop account, never leaving Copper’s custody, with full visibility into margin agreements, reducing unsecured counterparty exposure. 
 
- For Dealers, this structure provides capital-efficient hedging on ClearLoop, reduced settlement friction and the ability to continue offering competitive pricing 
 
If you’re curious to learn more, connect with our team.

https://t.co/l6P3dK8H5q

Who sets the rules when regulators can't agree? 
And when does "hybrid finance" just become... finance?

$200M to $2B per month.

That's how fast stablecoin settlement has grown — and it's just one signal
all_tweets.description:
$200M to $2B per month.

That's how fast stablecoin settlement has grown — and it's just one signal of where tokenized payments are heading 🚀

This morning @rangoldi joined a debate hosted by the EPA alongside @KPMG, @ThunesPayments, and @coinbase on the readiness of tokenized money in payments.

His take: demand is real, it's growing, and $1.2 trillion in tokenized payment volume last year proves it.

But he cautions: senior executives at major global companies still claim tokenized payments are not even on their radar.

The infrastructure is ready. The volumes are growing. Mainstream awareness is the last gap to close.

#Money2020Asia

all_tweets.description:
Yesterday at @money2020 Asia, Fireblocks' SVP Payments & Network @rangoldi moderated a panel on why payouts are becoming the next competitive battleground.

The numbers that stopped the room:

✅$30T locked in nostro/vostro accounts = dead capital
✅6.2% average cost of a $200 cross-border transfer
✅@Visa settling ~$5B in stablecoins this year alone
✅@Tazapay delivering 99% of payments in under 15 minutes at sub-0.5% cost

Some of the highlights of Goldi's discussion with Aayush Singhania (@Tazapay), Jess Houlgrave (@WalletConnect) and Nischint Sanghavi (@Visa) in 🧵

all_tweets.title: Qivalis, the upcoming euro stablecoin of a consortium of 12 banks, will use Fireblocks’ (@Fireblocks
all_tweets.description:
Qivalis, the upcoming euro stablecoin of a consortium of 12 banks, will use Fireblocks’ (@FireblocksHQ) digital asset infrastructure.🔥

The MiCAR-compliant project will launch in the second half of 2026.

The consortium supporting the new euro stablecoin includes Banca Sella, CaixaBank, Danske Bank, DekaBank, ING, KBC, Raiffeisen Bank International, SEB, UniCredit, BBVA, BNP Paribas, and DZ Bank.💰

Backed one-to-one by the euro and built to meet MiCAR standards, Qivalis will deliver 24/7 near-instant payments and settlements on blockchain.

Fireblocks is supplying the institutional-grade infrastructure, tokenization engine, and built-in compliance tools for AML, KYC, sanctions screening, and audit-ready reporting.📜

Each participating bank will be able to offer custody, wallets, and payment services related to the stablecoin directly to clients.

In a stablecoin market currently worth $322 billion and dominated by USD assets, Qivalis is poised to put euro-backed digital money on the global stage with real institutional scale and security.📈

Check out the full coverage of this story on Blockzeit⏬
https://t.co/dEJVJ0ZHNy

all_tweets.title:
Power is the next optics.

Several people have asked me about this: when optics scales in datacenter
all_tweets.description:
Power is the next optics.

Several people have asked me about this: when optics scales in datacenters, it uses a lot more power than we are used to in the copper world.

Optimizing power delivery for efficiency becomes important.

Like CPO moved the optical engine to the silicon, IVRs will move power conversion to the silicon too.

Higher voltage architectures, better power converters, and more tighter integration will drive power usage lower— which is among the biggest limiting factors for growth of AI in the US.

all_tweets.title: GRAYSCALE DROPS COINBASE FROM AMENDED HYPERLIQUID ETF FILING, JOINS BITWISE AND 21SHARES IN PICKING
all_tweets.description:
GRAYSCALE DROPS COINBASE FROM AMENDED HYPERLIQUID ETF FILING, JOINS BITWISE AND 21SHARES IN PICKING ANCHORAGE

@Grayscale has filed an amendment to its proposed Hyperliquid ETF, replacing Coinbase Custody with Anchorage Digital as custodian. The move completes a pattern across all three pending GHYP-style filings, with Bitwise (BHYP) and 21Shares (THYP) having made the same switch in their own amendments earlier this month.

Coinbase has been the default custodian for nearly every US spot crypto ETF approved to date, including the $BTC and $ETH lineups. Its absence from all three Hyperliquid ETF filings stands out, particularly given Hyperliquid's direct competitive overlap with Coinbase Derivatives in the perpetual futures market.

Anchorage Digital (@Anchorage), the only federally chartered crypto bank in the US, emerges as the institutional custody winner for the HYPE ETF race. Hyperliquid trades around $41 with $HYPE up roughly 200% over the past year, driven by record perps volumes and an aggressive buyback-and-burn mechanism funded by trading fees.

all_tweets.description:
Divini Homines 12, 0035 [November 22, 2025]

Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance and/or Use to Safeguard Financial Stability, Investor Protection and Monetary Sovereignty.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Grand Rising, Everyone. 

Happy Divini Homines 12, 0035, also known as November 22, 2025. Different timeline. 

You can see how fast my hair has grown since my last haircut, just so many days ago. 

Here now is the Royal Decree issued by Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First, Queen and Commander-in-Chief of The Kingdom of Canada and The World, Living Crown Custodian of Earth and Humanity, Commander-in-Chief of United Armies of Earth under Natural Law. 

Dates November 22, 2025. 

Royal Decree name, Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance and/or Use to Safeguard Financial Stability, Investor Protection and Monetary Sovereignty. 

Whereas stablecoins despite their name, have demonstrated significant volatility and systemic risk, as evidenced by the collapse of algorithmic stable points, such as TerraUSD, also known as UST, in year 2022. 

These digital assets introduce risks to The Kingdom of Canada's financial system, including run risks, lack of transparency and threats to monetary sovereignty. The Kingdom of Canada's Securities Administrators and The Kingdom of Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions have identified these risks as critical and have called for strict regulatory oversight. 

Now, therefore, I, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana, Didulo The First, hereby issue under Natural Law this Decree. 

1] Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance. 

It is hereby prohibited to issue, operate, or facilitate the use of any stablecoin within the jurisdiction of The Kingdom of Canada. This includes both algorithmic and fiat-backed currency stablecoins, as both present significant risks to financial stability and investor protection. 

2] Ban on Stablecoin Transactions. 

Financial institutions in The Kingdom of Canada, payment service providers, and digital asset platform, platforms operating within The Kingdom of Canada are prohibited from facilitating transactions involving stablecoins. This includes the exchange, transfer, or storage of stablecoins on Canadian soil or through The Kingdom of Canada Canadian-based services. 

3] Monetary Sovereignty and Policy Integrity. 

I, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First, under Natural Law, reaffirms the role of the National Treasury of The Kingdom of Canada in monetary policy. The use of stablecoins, particularly those pegged to foreign currencies, undermines the Treasury's ability to manage the economy effectively. 

Therefore, I, Her Royal Majesty, Queen Romana Didulo The First of The Kingdom of Canada, will take all necessary measures to ensure that The Kingdom of Canada dollar, backed by gold and silver, remains the primary medium of exchange and store of value within The Kingdom of Canada. 

4] Investor Protection and Transparency. 

The prohibition of stablecoins is intended to protect Canadian Nationals, investors from the risk of unregulated financial instruments, lack of transparency, and lack of recourse in the event of failure. 

5] Enforcement and Compliance. 

The Kingdom of Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, The Kingdom of Canada's Securities Administrators, and other relevant regulatory Bodies under Natural Law are authorized to enforce the Decree and take necessary actions to ensure compliance. 

Violations of this Royal Decree will result in legal criminal consequences, including fines, penalties, or revocation of operating licenses and or imprisonment.

This Royal Decree is effective immediately, Signed, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First. November 22, 2025.

policy.description:
Divini Homines 12, 0035 [November 22, 2025]

Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance and/or Use to Safeguard Financial Stability, Investor Protection and Monetary Sovereignty.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Grand Rising, Everyone. 

Happy Divini Homines 12, 0035, also known as November 22, 2025. Different timeline. 

You can see how fast my hair has grown since my last haircut, just so many days ago. 

Here now is the Royal Decree issued by Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First, Queen and Commander-in-Chief of The Kingdom of Canada and The World, Living Crown Custodian of Earth and Humanity, Commander-in-Chief of United Armies of Earth under Natural Law. 

Dates November 22, 2025. 

Royal Decree name, Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance and/or Use to Safeguard Financial Stability, Investor Protection and Monetary Sovereignty. 

Whereas stablecoins despite their name, have demonstrated significant volatility and systemic risk, as evidenced by the collapse of algorithmic stable points, such as TerraUSD, also known as UST, in year 2022. 

These digital assets introduce risks to The Kingdom of Canada's financial system, including run risks, lack of transparency and threats to monetary sovereignty. The Kingdom of Canada's Securities Administrators and The Kingdom of Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions have identified these risks as critical and have called for strict regulatory oversight. 

Now, therefore, I, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana, Didulo The First, hereby issue under Natural Law this Decree. 

1] Prohibition of Stablecoin Issuance. 

It is hereby prohibited to issue, operate, or facilitate the use of any stablecoin within the jurisdiction of The Kingdom of Canada. This includes both algorithmic and fiat-backed currency stablecoins, as both present significant risks to financial stability and investor protection. 

2] Ban on Stablecoin Transactions. 

Financial institutions in The Kingdom of Canada, payment service providers, and digital asset platform, platforms operating within The Kingdom of Canada are prohibited from facilitating transactions involving stablecoins. This includes the exchange, transfer, or storage of stablecoins on Canadian soil or through The Kingdom of Canada Canadian-based services. 

3] Monetary Sovereignty and Policy Integrity. 

I, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First, under Natural Law, reaffirms the role of the National Treasury of The Kingdom of Canada in monetary policy. The use of stablecoins, particularly those pegged to foreign currencies, undermines the Treasury's ability to manage the economy effectively. 

Therefore, I, Her Royal Majesty, Queen Romana Didulo The First of The Kingdom of Canada, will take all necessary measures to ensure that The Kingdom of Canada dollar, backed by gold and silver, remains the primary medium of exchange and store of value within The Kingdom of Canada. 

4] Investor Protection and Transparency. 

The prohibition of stablecoins is intended to protect Canadian Nationals, investors from the risk of unregulated financial instruments, lack of transparency, and lack of recourse in the event of failure. 

5] Enforcement and Compliance. 

The Kingdom of Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, The Kingdom of Canada's Securities Administrators, and other relevant regulatory Bodies under Natural Law are authorized to enforce the Decree and take necessary actions to ensure compliance. 

Violations of this Royal Decree will result in legal criminal consequences, including fines, penalties, or revocation of operating licenses and or imprisonment.

This Royal Decree is effective immediately, Signed, Her Royal Majesty Queen Romana Didulo The First. November 22, 2025.

company.title: Copper has expanded its OTC derivatives solution with the launch of ClearLoop Assigned Collateral, a
company.description:
Copper has expanded its OTC derivatives solution with the launch of ClearLoop Assigned Collateral, adding to its existing triparty pledge service. 
 
Structural tension around collateral has long challenged OTC crypto derivatives markets; balancing Dealers’ capital efficiency with Takers’ need to manage counterparty risk.
 
Our new solution, powered by ClearLoop, delivers both. 
 
- For Takers, collateral is restricted for use within the Dealer’s ClearLoop account, never leaving Copper’s custody, with full visibility into margin agreements, reducing unsecured counterparty exposure. 
 
- For Dealers, this structure provides capital-efficient hedging on ClearLoop, reduced settlement friction and the ability to continue offering competitive pricing 
 
If you’re curious to learn more, connect with our team.

https://t.co/l6P3dK8H5q

That's how fast stablecoin settlement has grown — and it's just one signal
company.description:
$200M to $2B per month.

That's how fast stablecoin settlement has grown — and it's just one signal of where tokenized payments are heading 🚀

This morning @rangoldi joined a debate hosted by the EPA alongside @KPMG, @ThunesPayments, and @coinbase on the readiness of tokenized money in payments.

His take: demand is real, it's growing, and $1.2 trillion in tokenized payment volume last year proves it.

But he cautions: senior executives at major global companies still claim tokenized payments are not even on their radar.

The infrastructure is ready. The volumes are growing. Mainstream awareness is the last gap to close.

#Money2020Asia

company.title: Qivalis, the upcoming euro stablecoin of a consortium of 12 banks, will use Fireblocks’ (@Fireblocks
company.description:
Qivalis, the upcoming euro stablecoin of a consortium of 12 banks, will use Fireblocks’ (@FireblocksHQ) digital asset infrastructure.🔥

The MiCAR-compliant project will launch in the second half of 2026.

The consortium supporting the new euro stablecoin includes Banca Sella, CaixaBank, Danske Bank, DekaBank, ING, KBC, Raiffeisen Bank International, SEB, UniCredit, BBVA, BNP Paribas, and DZ Bank.💰

Backed one-to-one by the euro and built to meet MiCAR standards, Qivalis will deliver 24/7 near-instant payments and settlements on blockchain.

Fireblocks is supplying the institutional-grade infrastructure, tokenization engine, and built-in compliance tools for AML, KYC, sanctions screening, and audit-ready reporting.📜

Each participating bank will be able to offer custody, wallets, and payment services related to the stablecoin directly to clients.

In a stablecoin market currently worth $322 billion and dominated by USD assets, Qivalis is poised to put euro-backed digital money on the global stage with real institutional scale and security.📈

Check out the full coverage of this story on Blockzeit⏬
https://t.co/dEJVJ0ZHNy

Power is the next optics.

Several people have asked me about this: when optics scales in datacenter
company.description:
Power is the next optics.

Several people have asked me about this: when optics scales in datacenters, it uses a lot more power than we are used to in the copper world.

Optimizing power delivery for efficiency becomes important.

Like CPO moved the optical engine to the silicon, IVRs will move power conversion to the silicon too.

Higher voltage architectures, better power converters, and more tighter integration will drive power usage lower— which is among the biggest limiting factors for growth of AI in the US.

company.title: GRAYSCALE DROPS COINBASE FROM AMENDED HYPERLIQUID ETF FILING, JOINS BITWISE AND 21SHARES IN PICKING
company.description:
GRAYSCALE DROPS COINBASE FROM AMENDED HYPERLIQUID ETF FILING, JOINS BITWISE AND 21SHARES IN PICKING ANCHORAGE

@Grayscale has filed an amendment to its proposed Hyperliquid ETF, replacing Coinbase Custody with Anchorage Digital as custodian. The move completes a pattern across all three pending GHYP-style filings, with Bitwise (BHYP) and 21Shares (THYP) having made the same switch in their own amendments earlier this month.

Coinbase has been the default custodian for nearly every US spot crypto ETF approved to date, including the $BTC and $ETH lineups. Its absence from all three Hyperliquid ETF filings stands out, particularly given Hyperliquid's direct competitive overlap with Coinbase Derivatives in the perpetual futures market.

Anchorage Digital (@Anchorage), the only federally chartered crypto bank in the US, emerges as the institutional custody winner for the HYPE ETF race. Hyperliquid trades around $41 with $HYPE up roughly 200% over the past year, driven by record perps volumes and an aggressive buyback-and-burn mechanism funded by trading fees.
